issue.title: QFX payee cleaning misses WF card tails: card last-4 leaks into vault rows and learned naming almost never fires
issue.description:
Wells Fargo QFX descriptions end in `PURCHASE MM/DD <place> <ST> CARD dddd` (no
`AUTHORIZED ON` phrase), but `clean_description` in `src/native/bank/naming.rs` only
strips the CSV shapes: its auth-prefix stage requires `PURCHASE AUTHORIZED ON ` /
`AUTHORIZED ON `, and its card-suffix stage requires an `S<digits> CARD dddd` 3-token
tail. On the real import journal (850 txns, May–Nov 2026), 86% of descriptions carry
the bare `CARD dddd` tail and 0% contain `AUTHORIZED ON`, so neither stage fires.

Two impacts from the one root cause:

1. **Privacy:** imported rows keep the raw tail, so the card's last four digits are
   written into git-synced vault text. 6 of the 7 rows in `bank/2026-11.md` carry card
   last-4 today (verified 2026-11-13; vault @ 962024aea). ACH/P2P payees also keep
   reference numbers and the account-holder name.
2. **Learning:** the purchase date inside the uncleaned text pollutes `merchant_key`,
   so the tier-2 learned-payee lookup almost never matches a repeat merchant
   (~19% raw repeat rate vs ~63%+ once the tail is stripped — measured on the journal).
   Learned payee/category/link inheritance is effectively dead on QFX data.

Suggested fix (root cause is precise): add QFX strip stages
(`PURCHASE[ RETURN] [AUTHORIZED ON ]MM/DD …[ CARD dddd]`, `RECURRING PAYMENT …`),
strip processor order codes (`*` + short digit-bearing token, keeping `*` + word
sub-merchants), mask long digit runs / drop account-holder-name tails on ACH/P2P, and
run the cleaner over learned payees before reuse so existing uncleaned rows cannot
teach the noise forward. `merchant_key` inherits via `clean_description` and `learn()`
recomputes from the journal, so no migration is needed. Synthetic fixtures only.

Full analysis: the consolidated research report (ref attached), §"The prerequisite:
QFX cleaning". This defect blocks the planned one-keypress category card from being
useful (suggestions almost never fire without it) but is a real defect on its own.

task_type_fields.impact: Card last-4 digits and ACH reference/name tails in git-synced vault text; tier-2 learned payee/category inheritance effectively never matches (date-polluted merchant keys), leaving imports uncategorized
task_type_fields.repro: Import a Wells Fargo QFX; inspect written rows in bank/<YYYY-MM>.md (raw 'PURCHASE MM/DD ... CARD dddd' tails survive). Aggregate check: grep the .bob/bank/*.jsonl desc fields for 'CARD <dddd>$' (86% of 850) and 'AUTHORIZED ON' (0%).

issue.creation_reason: Found while consolidating bank-tracking research: verified in naming.rs and on the live import journal; the leak and dead learned tier exist today regardless of whether the planned category-card epic proceeds
